cornerstone.notes: Independently re-verified against PDF page 264 (printed page 255). The quote matches the prospectus verbatim: 'Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the "Lock-up Period"), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares ... save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries or affiliates (as the case may be) who will be bound by the same obligations ...'. Listing Date confirmed as 'expected to be on or about Tuesday, September 29, 2026' (PDF p40, Definitions). Under the repository convention ('from (and inclusive of)' -> anniversary exclusive), the restricted period runs 2026-09-29 through 2027-03-28 inclusive; first free day 2027-03-29 is correct. Holder list cross-checked against the Cornerstone Placing table on PDF pages 259-260: Temasek, Sunpeak Asset, IvyRock, E Fund, E Fund Management, E Fund HK, CIG, Winner Global Fund, Wind Sabre, Vestide Lumir, Arrowpoint, Sino Opulence Fund, Roofer Asset Management, Bloom Capital, Mr. Lai Pak Lam, Mr. Xia Shengli, Mr. Zhu Guodong, Mr. Zheng Xiaofeng = 18 investors, matching the candidate. Aggregates verified: US$232.4 million / 4,179,950 H Shares at max Offer Price HK$436.00 (PDF pp257, 259). No corrections.

controller_6m.notes: Independently re-verified against PDF page 273 (printed page 264, footer '- 264 -'). The quote matches the prospectus verbatim, including the Rule 10.07 formulation: '... in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of his/its shareholding is made in this prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date, dispose of, or enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of those shares or securities ...'. Holder verified: 'Single Largest Shareholder Group' is defined (PDF p43) as 'Mr. Dai, Yuanjiesheng and Ningbo Kejun collectively, being our single largest shareholder group following the completion of the Global Offering'; shareholdings Yuanjiesheng ~23.66%, Ningbo Kejun ~3.87%, Mr. Dai ~3.93% (PDF p123) match the candidate's notes. Date computation verified under the repository convention ('ending on the date which is N months from' -> anniversary inclusive): end date 2027-03-29 inclusive, last restricted day 2027-03-29, first free day 2027-03-30. Both non-standard features confirmed: (1) holder is the Single Largest Shareholder Group, not a defined Listing Rules Controlling Shareholder; (2) period commences on the prospectus shareholding-disclosure date, earlier than the Listing Date. No corrections.

controller_12m.notes: Absence independently confirmed. Searches for '12 months from the Listing Date', 'cease to be a controlling shareholder' and '18C' return no hits. The only 'Second Six Month Period' hit (PDF p274, printed 264) is part of the Company-side Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertaking (market-stability step-in if the Company itself issues/disposes during the six months after the First Six Month Period expires) - it is NOT a shareholder-side 12-month control-maintenance lockup. All 'twelve' hits are unrelated (business licensing, accounting policies, interest-rate sensitivity). 'Controlling Shareholder' appears only in the PRC/A-share regulatory context (Yuanjiesheng as controlling shareholder of the Shenzhen-listed entity; CSRC Jiangsu Bureau / SZSE regulatory letters, PDF pp16, 18, 177, 179), confirming no Listing Rules 'Controlling Shareholder' is designated for the HK-listed entity and hence no second six-month Rule 10.07(2)(b)-style control covenant. The entire Rule 10.07 undertaking on PDF p273 is a single six-month paragraph. exists=false is correct. No corrections.
